prompt.content: What was the estimated peak wind speed of Tropical Storm Vamei according to the Joint Typhoon Warning Center?

output:
Tropical Storm Vamei did not reach a peak wind speed as it was never classified as a full-fledged typhoon. The Joint Typhoon Warning Center (JTWC) noted that Vamei was a weak tropical storm that was being affected by the terrain and wind shear.
